title: Motion
description: full = a press stays amber for a moment and settles into the tape, a released key's underline lets go softly, a new peak is marked; below 16 keys per second only. reduced = the block still fades in and out; no settling, release fade or peak mark. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Orientation
description: auto: follows the page's box (wider than tall: one row per key, presses travel sideways; otherwise one column per key, presses travel up or down). Size the source or layer to change it.

title: Caps side
description: Where the key caps sit; presses travel away from them. auto: left when horizontal, bottom when vertical. start: left / top. end: right / bottom.

title: Scroll speed
description: How fast presses travel along the tape, in pixels per real second at the overlay's natural size (it scales with the page; rate mods are compensated). 100–3000.

title: Show press counts
description: Presses of this attempt under each key label.

title: Press tape in osu!mania
description: Also draw the scrolling press tape in osu!mania. Off: caps and counts only, because the stage beside it already shows the same notes; on is for replay review.

title: Smoke lane (osu!)
description: Adds a lane for the osu! smoke key.

title: Keys per second
description: Live and peak keys per second (the same number as key-counter and kps-graph).
